description: This PHP script manages creating, editing, deleting, and managing test suites and test cases in the TestLink test management tool. It includes functions for handling test suite operations like adding, copying, moving, deleting, reordering, and modifying test suites and test cases, as well as utilities for initializing editors, handling form submissions, and user permissions.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP object used throughout the script for passing data structures and configuration.

methods.name: getValuesFromPost
methods.description: Extracts specified form field values from the POST request, stripping slashes.

methods.name: build_del_testsuite_warning_msg
methods.description: Builds warning, link, and delete messages for test suite deletion confirmation, analyzing linked test cases and execution status.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and extracts parameters from the request for processing test suite and test case operations.

methods.name: writeCustomFieldsToDB
methods.description: Saves custom field values associated with a test suite to the database.

methods.name: deleteTestSuite
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a test suite, including permission checks, cascading deletes, and user confirmation workflow.

methods.name: addTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite with optional keyword assignment, custom fields, and triggers related events.

methods.name: moveTestSuite
methods.description: Changes the parent container of a test suite, reordering within the new parent.

methods.name: updateTestSuite
methods.description: Updates attributes of an existing test suite, including name, details, and associated keywords.

methods.name: copyTestSuite
methods.description: Duplicates an existing test suite into a specified container, maintaining order and copying associated keywords and attachments.

methods.name: moveTestTestCasesViewer
methods.description: Prepares variables for displaying the 'move test case' interface, including test cases, test plans, statuses, and UI configuration.

methods.name: copyTestCases
methods.description: Copies selected test cases from one suite to another, with options for duplicate name handling and keyword copying.

methods.name: deleteTestCasesViewer
methods.description: Prepares variables for deleting test cases, including fetching linked execution status and permissions.

methods.name: doDeleteTestCases
methods.description: Deletes specified test cases from the database.

methods.name: reorderTestCasesByCriteria
methods.description: Reorders test cases in a test suite based on a configured criterion (name or external ID).

methods.name: reorderTestCasesDictionary
methods.description: Reorders test cases alphabetically by name within a test suite.

methods.name: reorderTestCasesByExtID
methods.description: Reorders test cases within a suite based on external IDs.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes user interface parameters, including labels, permissions, and attachment info for a test suite

methods.name: showTestSuite
methods.description: Displays the test suite page with the appropriate data and interface.

methods.name: initWebEditors
methods.description: Initializes web editor components for editing test suite data.
